source: Spec 124 R-DA (McDonald's Airtight V3): every entry is the measured PRE -> POST diff of docs/reports/golden/classify_coa_scope/{pre,post}/{coa,standalone}.json. PRE = the legacy-shell captures of Night A-swap 2026-10-22 (lane COA-ASWAP); POST = the converted-shell captures retaken in the Fleet recapture night 2026-10-22 (run-20261022b; Spec 132 §x-captures.3 (R-DA); Q-B refresh from VALIDATE-REPORT-2 §2). Each why is explained from the descriptor deviation, register rule, runner code or the captures' own measured values it names, and states tonight's cause (the committed A-swap POSTs were empty-cursor runs; tonight's plain coa POSTs did real pending work because the coa root ran first). table_state coa_applications moves f25acf92 -> 0cdcc2cf in both files (see table_state[0].content_hash); row count 33,982 unchanged.

diffs.why: R-EQ shell swap: the legacy shell hand-printed JSON-log lines ("Loaded 35 trade configs / 805 logic variables from control panel", "Classification complete" with a context object) and a hyphenated completion line; the runner prints its own lines (the target line "database=postgres user=postgres migrations=<n>", the ledger-gate line where the step gates, the PIPELINE_SUMMARY and PIPELINE_META lines and one "[classify_coa_scope] completed in <DUR>" line). Log lines only: no table, counter or verdict value is read from them, and the PIPELINE_SUMMARY content is diffed separately in the summary.* keys.

scripts/classify-coa-scope.descriptor.json deviations[0] (Spec 124 R-DE (iv), O1 ruling 2026-09-21): audit_table.phase follows sharing.varies_by_chain.phase, the step's 1-based coa-chain index 6, generated by scripts/generate-sharing-phase.js; the legacy literal was 42 (the Spec 42 chain number).
The library stamps every declared check row with observed before_write / after_write (FLEET-2 lib #52); the legacy hand-built rows had no such field.

The library stamps every declared check row with source "check" and every compute context row with source "context" (verdict.js checkRow / contextRow); the legacy hand-built rows carried no source field.

The library renders the declared limit in force (e.g. "viol == 0", "pct <= 10") on each declared check row; the legacy rows carried the limit as prose or not at all. The bound is the step-owned variable in summary.records_meta.config.

Same metrics, same order. Run outcome, not a behaviour change (VALIDATE-REPORT-2 §2; Defect Ledger CCS-D1, COA-D14): the legacy PRE coa capture classified the 2,448 CoAs pending after the 2026-10-22 coa feed refresh. Tonight the coa root ran first (block 097) and touched last_seen_at on 2,699 fed keys (the R-DZ seen column, Spec 132 §ingestor.5 (R-DZ, R-EX)), which re-pends every fed CoA under the pinned cursor scope_classified_at IS NULL OR scope_classified_at < last_seen_at (scripts/lib/compute/classify-coa-scope.js:34-41, W4A-R4 (a)). The converted coa POST (block 103) therefore classified 2,442 CoAs, 2,329 with a scope class, within a few CoAs of the legacy PRE. Both standalone captures (PRE, and POST block 104) streamed an empty cursor. Value moves on the coa capture: coa_processed 2448 -> 2442, scope_classified 2334 -> 2329, unmapped 4.7% -> 4.6%, scope_classified_pct 95.3% -> 95.4%, no_class 506 -> 503, coa_type_class_null_pct 20.7% -> 20.6%, no_project_type 245 -> 243, structure_type_classified_pct 47.6% -> 47.7%, and the distribution buckets (rows[].value.<bucket>). The standalone audit values are 0 in both.

scripts/classify-coa-scope.descriptor.json: the legacy row unmapped_scope_count (a percentage printed as "4.7%") is renamed unmapped_scope_pct, the declared check id; the metric then reads the value the name says. Every other legacy metric keeps its name and order.

unmapped_scope_pct is a declared check (limit pct <= classify_coa_scope_unmapped_max_pct 10, severity WARN) and renders PASS in all four captures. scope_classified_pct is a descriptive INFO field_coverage check in the descriptor, so the converted run renders it INFO (coa 95.4%, standalone 0.0%) where the legacy shell printed PASS (coa 95.3%, standalone 0.0%): a status rendering, not a threshold or value change. Verdict PASS in all four captures.
